description:
Find candidate tariff codes for products. Best for: "what HS code could this product use?" for up to 20 product titles, from the UK Trade Tariff and, if asked, the US Harmonized Tariff Schedule.
Returns: up to 3 candidates per product and market with code, description and source. Every code is a candidate, not binding; a large list may be cut short and says so per product.
Input tips: products (1 to 20) of {title, optional description}, such as {"products": [{"title": "ceramic coffee mug"}], "markets": ["UK"]}. markets is UK, US or both (default UK).
Hand-off: to get a duty amount, copy a candidate's code into landed_cost_estimate hs_code. It needs a full line: 10 digits for the UK, 8 or 10 for the US. A shorter code must first be narrowed to a full line.
Not for: a binding classification or a duty amount by itself.

markets.description: Tariff schedules to search (default UK). Searching both uses more of the per-call request allowance, so large lists may be cut short.

products.description: 1 to 20 products to find candidate tariff codes for, each {title, optional description}, such as [{"title": "ceramic coffee mug"}].

description.description: A line about what it is made of or used for (used when the title finds nothing)

title.description: Product name, such as "women's cotton t-shirt"

name: bulk_hs_candidates

code.description: Tariff code. Pass it to landed_cost_estimate as hs_code once it is a full line (UK 10 digits, US 8 or 10).

note.description: Why a market has no candidates or was not searched, with the next step.

status.description: Every code below is a candidate, not binding.
